faq.page_subtitle: Everything you need to know about ReadyCV, AI features, and the Pro plan
faq.q1: What does the Pro plan include?
faq.a1: The Pro plan includes: 139 professional templates, unlimited CVs, 7 AI tools (bullets, summary, ATS Score, skills, review, profile fill, cover letter), PDF and Word export, job application tracker, shareable public CV, and version history.
faq.q2: Can I switch templates without losing my data?
faq.a2: Yes. Your data is separated from the template. You can switch between all 139 templates at any time and your content remains intact.
faq.q3: What formats can I download my resume in?
faq.a3: You can download in high-resolution PDF or Word (.docx), ready to edit. Both formats are included in the Pro plan.
faq.q4: Can I create more than one resume?
faq.a4: Yes. With the Pro plan you can create unlimited resumes, allowing you to tailor your CV for different positions or industries.
faq.q5: Can I import my existing resume?
faq.a5: Yes. You can import your resume in PDF or Word (.docx) format and the system will automatically extract your information to populate the editor.
faq.a6: Absolutely. We use bank-level encryption and never share your data with third parties. You can delete your account and all your data at any time.
faq.a_ai1: ReadyCV uses OpenAI GPT-4o-mini to power its 7 AI tools. Each tool is specialized: it analyzes your profile context, sector, and job posting to generate relevant, professional content — not generic text.
faq.q_ai2: What does the bullet improvement tool do?
faq.a_ai2: It takes each bullet point in your work experience and rewrites it with powerful action verbs, impact metrics, and results-oriented structure. It gives you 3 versions to choose the one that best fits your style.
faq.q_ai3: What does the AI professional summary generate?
faq.a_ai3: It generates a 3-4 line paragraph summarizing your background, specialty, and value proposition. It analyzes your entire profile (experience, skills, education) to create a coherent and compelling text.
faq.q_ai4: How does the AI profile fill work?
faq.a_ai4: You describe your background in free text (max 500 characters) and the AI automatically extracts: job title, summary, suggested skills, and work experience improvements. Ideal if you are starting from scratch.
faq.q_ai5: What is the AI CV review?
faq.a_ai5: A complete analysis of your resume that identifies strengths, weaknesses, and concrete improvements. Each suggestion includes a button to apply it directly with one click, seeing the difference before accepting.
faq.q_ai6: How does the cover letter generator work?
faq.a_ai6: It analyzes your full CV and the job posting to generate a personalized, formal, and convincing letter. You can edit it with the built-in rich text editor and generate variants if you are not satisfied with the first version.
faq.a_ats1: ATS (Applicant Tracking System) are algorithms used by 98% of large companies to automatically filter resumes before a human recruiter sees them. ReadyCV ATS Score analyzes how compatible your resume is with a specific job posting.
faq.a_ats2: You paste the job posting text and ReadyCV compares your resume against it: detects present and missing keywords, analyzes skills, experience and education compatibility, and gives you a compatibility percentage with specific recommendations.
faq.q_ats3: Does a high ATS Score guarantee the job?
faq.a_ats3: It does not guarantee the job, but it does guarantee your resume reaches human eyes. 75% of resumes are rejected by ATS filters before anyone reads them. A high score eliminates that barrier.
faq.a_ats4: Yes. All templates are designed with clean formats and semantic structures that ATS systems can parse correctly. We avoid complex tables, illogical multi-column layouts, and graphic elements that confuse automated systems.
faq.a_tpl1: There are 139 templates organized into more than 10 categories: Technology, Design, Legal, Healthcare, Hospitality, Finance, Education, Marketing, Executive, and more. All included in the Pro plan.
faq.a_tpl2: Yes. Each template has predefined color schemes you can change from the editor. You can also adjust fonts, sizes, and section order.
faq.q_plan1: How much does the Pro plan cost?
faq.a_plan1: $15/month or $144/year (equivalent to $12/month, saving 20%). There is no free plan — the Pro plan includes full access to everything without restrictions.
faq.q_plan2: Can I cancel at any time?
faq.a_plan2: Yes. Cancel anytime from your profile, with no commitments or penalties. You keep access until the end of your paid period.
faq.q_priv1: Does ReadyCV use my resume to train AI?
faq.a_priv1: No. Your data is never used to train AI models. Each AI request is processed in isolation and not stored as training data. This is reflected in our Privacy Policy.
faq.q_priv2: Can I delete my account and data?
faq.a_priv2: Yes. From Settings → Account you can permanently delete your account. All your CVs, letters, applications, and personal data are immediately and irreversibly deleted (GDPR Art. 17 compliance).
